name: Samuel Wang
intro: I'm a roboticist based in the San Francisco Bay Area, passionate about building robots that can understand their environment, take on intelligent tasks, and make a real, positive impact on people's lives. I was born in Southern California, raised in Taiwan for 20 years, and moved back to the States for grad school and work. I hold an MS in Robotics from Carnegie Mellon University, and an MS and BS in Mechanical Engineering from National Chiao Tung University (交通大學).
